## The App

Mindly provides short puzzle games, including daily puzzles and archived puzzles. Features may include:

- Daily puzzle access
- Archive puzzle access
- Streaks and stats
- Puzzle progress saved on your device
- Spoiler-free sharing
- Optional reminders
- Paid subscription access to archived puzzles

We may add, remove, update, pause, or change games, features, puzzle content, or app functionality over time.

## Accounts

Mindly does not currently require an account. If account features are added later, additional terms or policies may apply.

## Daily Puzzles and Archive Access

Daily puzzles may be available without a paid subscription.

Archive access may require an active monthly subscription. Archive availability, included puzzles, and subscription benefits may change over time.

We do not guarantee that every past puzzle will always remain available, or that puzzle content will be available without interruption.

## Subscriptions and Billing

Mindly may offer a monthly paid subscription for archive access.

Subscriptions are processed through the app store platform where you obtained the app, such as Google Play. Subscription billing, renewal, cancellation, refunds, and payment methods are handled by the app store platform and are subject to that platform's terms and policies.

Unless canceled according to the app store's rules, subscriptions may renew automatically. You are responsible for managing or canceling your subscription through your app store account settings.

We do not receive or store your full payment card information.

## Refunds

Refunds, if available, are handled by the app store platform where the purchase was made. We cannot guarantee refunds outside the app store's policies.
